quotes.text: The Moon represents feelings and emotions. She is an instinctual, intuitive, nurturing planet, but also a planet that fosters emotional attachment to the form she provides.
quotes.chapter: CANCER: The Search for the Mother Goddess

quotes.text: The Moon, Cancer's ruler, has been called in both India and the West (in Plato's writings, particularly) the Giver of Form.
quotes.chapter: CANCER: The Search for the Mother Goddess

quotes.text: The Moon was a bestower of the gifts of feeling, of intuition, and of nurturing instincts which men did not seem to possess.
quotes.chapter: CANCER: The Search for the Mother Goddess

quotes.text: Here, the most feminine planet rules the most feminine sign. The Moon has many phases, corresponding to the many moods of Cancer.
quotes.chapter: Introduction

quotes.text: Cancer, the Cosmic Womb, is also the first Water sign.
quotes.chapter: CANCER: The Search for the Mother Goddess

quotes.text: The archetype of Cancer is the Cosmic Womb in which the seeds of creativity grow and burst forth in diverse ways—biological, artistic or intuitive creativity, imaginative creativity, even business creativity.
quotes.chapter: CANCER: The Search for the Mother Goddess

quotes.text: Within the Great Mother archetype are two distinct personalities—the Gentle Mother like Kwan Yin the Merciful and Compassionate of Chinese Mythology, and the Terrible Mother, like India's Kali Ma and the Greek Medusa.

quotes.chapter: GEMINI: The Search for Variety

quotes.text: He is the only one of the Greek Pantheon who had no home on Olympus but was always in transit among the three worlds. He was the Guide and Messenger for Olympus, Earth and Hades.
quotes.chapter: GEMINI: The Search for Variety

quotes.text: Hermes' gifts to Gemini and Virgo include a Mutable or flexible attitude towards life's changing circumstances; the ability to analyze one's errors and adapt one's behavior; a sense of humor about oneself, and a lively mental curiosity about life.
quotes.chapter: GEMINI: The Search for Variety

quotes.text: As ruler of the Earth sign Virgo, Hermes seems less flighty, more grounded, stable and consistent in his behavior than he was as ruler of airy Gemini.
quotes.chapter: VIRGO: The Search for Meaningful Service

quotes.text: In the process of alchemical purification Hermes' virtues are those of the Virgo archetype: patience, purification or perfectionism, meticulous attention to technique and procedure, obedience to methodology, industriousness, and most important, humility.
quotes.chapter: VIRGO: The Search for Meaningful Service

quotes.text: In Greek mythology, particularly in Homer's epics, Mercury's thinking, counseling role as wise Messenger God was played by Hermes or Athene, two almost interchangeable Logos symbols.
quotes.chapter: ARIES: The Search For a Separate Identity

quotes.text: The Aries at the esoteric level has begun to work consciously with Mercury (Logos), his/her spiritual ruler.
quotes.chapter: ARIES: The Search For a Separate Identity

quotes.text: Behind many a shy, simple Virgo personality hides magical Hermes.
quotes.chapter: VIRGO: The Search for Meaningful Service

quotes.text: Gemini is cheerful, playful, and somewhat glib, like its ruling planet Mercury/Hermes.
quotes.chapter: GEMINI: The Search for Variety

quotes.text: Each year as we enter Virgo, the mood of the Earth itself seems to become more withdrawn, introspective, quieter.
quotes.chapter: VIRGO: The Search for Meaningful Service

quotes.text: In Labours of Hercules, Alice Bailey amplifies Aphrodite's role as esoteric ruler when she reminds us that she is harmony—the Eros' power to reconcile opposites, to heal all misunderstandings and transcend duality in all its forms.

quotes.text: She is the unity principle that spans the Gates of Hercules.

quotes.text: She is Aphrodite, Goddess of Love, aesthetics and civilized good taste.

quotes.text: It is important for them to work consciously with the planets aspecting natal Venus to help Venus express its positive instincts—warmth, grace of self-expression, social comfort, artistic expression, and charm.
quotes.chapter: TAURUS: The Search for Value and Meaning

quotes.text: Most important, however, in my experience with Geminis who have developed their Venus (or esoteric ruler), is the warmth they project to others. Others in their lives feel loved, as well as analyzed.
quotes.chapter: GEMINI: The Search for Variety

quotes.text: Consciousness (Hermes) and love (Venus and Eros) combined form a very intuitive, creative partnership.
quotes.chapter: GEMINI: The Search for Variety

quotes.text: Passive, patient, and placid, Taurus earth is fertile and fecund sexuality.
quotes.chapter: TAURUS: The Search for Value and Meaning

quotes.text: Libra is the seventh sign of the zodiac. It is the second Air sign and because the third seasonal change occurs in Libra, it is the third Cardinal sign.

quotes.chapter: SCORPIO: The Search for the Transformation

quotes.text: Aries' energy is like the Sun's rays—clear or conscious, frank, direct, obvious, full of light and heat and visible to all.

quotes.text: Aries represents the "Irresistible Force," as Dane Rudhyar put it. This is the power of the ram's horns.

quotes.text: In every Sagittarian client—even those who seem to burn like forest fires out of control—there is this pure spark of Zeus' enthusiasm.

quotes.text: In astrology, we normally use transiting Jupiter to answer questions about moves and long-distance travel—about motion in the outer world. However, apparently the esoteric tradition experienced Jupiter through dreams and meditation as inner space, as what Jung called psychic space.
quotes.chapter: SAGITTARIUS: The Search for Wisdom

quotes.text: In India, Jupiter is known as Guru by astrologers.
quotes.chapter: SAGITTARIUS: The Search for Wisdom

quotes.text: Jupiter (opportunity) is the esoteric ruler of Aquarius.

quotes.text: Combining Jupiter and Uranus (the esoteric and mundane rulers of Aquarius) is the work of the New Age.

quotes.text: The Sagittarian, like his ruler, manifests big virtues and big vices.

quotes.chapter: SAGITTARIUS: The Search for Wisdom

quotes.text: There is a sense of playfulness to Sagittarius. It's rather like the stage in alchemy where hard work is over and there is the joy of spontaneous growth.
quotes.chapter: SAGITTARIUS: The Search for Wisdom

quotes.text: Two gifts of Saturn are patience and introspection.

quotes.text: Saturn is the greatest of teachers for those of us who are observant. How we react to Saturn transits indicates the level of our attunement.

quotes.text: One can almost see Chronus, or Saturn, as the Romans called him (Father Time) standing to one side holding his hour glass, or his sickle, while people make these Winter Solstice remarks.

quotes.text: At the mundane level, the Capricorn archetype can be recognized every year in conversations about shoulds and oughts, conflicting family duties, traditions, growing older, and an overwhelming feeling of being under pressure because "there's so little time."

quotes.chapter: VIRGO: The Search for Meaningful Service

quotes.text: Uranus is anxious to grow, to live in the now, while Saturn seeks to protect past traditions.

quotes.text: Uranus needs to be honored through discovery of new concepts, ideas, friends, organizations.

quotes.text: Uranus transits, if constructively used, may be productive time out from mundane, routinized living, to detach, gain perspective and look more objectively at the world through different and clearer lenses.
quotes.chapter: AQUARIUS: The Search for the Holy Grail

quotes.text: Uranus is the esoteric ruler of Libra. It's also the higher octave planet for Mercury, Virgo's mundane ruler. It refers to objectivity on the material, the data, the approach to the service.

quotes.text: Uranus has an objectivity about life's situations and injustices that helps Libra to stand back and detach rather than yield to Aphrodite, the mundane ruler, when she tries to take things too personally.

quotes.text: Aquarius is the last of the four powerful, magnetic, opinionated Fixed signs.

quotes.chapter: CANCER: The Search for the Mother Goddess

quotes.text: Neptune is the planet of faith, and faith is needed to let go of the past and open up to the future, rather than attempt to hang on to outworn forms with crab-like tenacity.
quotes.chapter: CANCER: The Search for the Mother Goddess

quotes.text: For those who can willingly sacrifice the old way, the old role, the old career, the old attachments, to Neptune; for those who dare to create, to use their imagination, to trust their intuition, Neptune is a liberator.
quotes.chapter: CANCER: The Search for the Mother Goddess

quotes.text: Remember—Poseidon does not dissolve anything we still need. He only prevents a Seeker from clinging to that which limits him, or stands in the way of his growth.
quotes.chapter: CANCER: The Search for the Mother Goddess

quotes.text: Neptune is not about apathy or feeling good in meditation, but about hearing and acting upon what God tells us to do in the outer world—acting from the inside (the Spiritual Center) outward.
quotes.chapter: PISCES: The Search for the Castle of Peace

quotes.text: Neptune's message is "Relax. Let go and let God have some room. Resign yourself to the idea that maybe you won't get there this lifetime, quit striving so hard, and then maybe you will get there after all."

quotes.text: Also, these rulers of Pisces point toward deeper truths, eternal truths in the depths of the cosmic ocean.
quotes.chapter: PISCES: The Search for the Castle of Peace

quotes.text: Pisces is the last of the four Mutable signs—Mutable Water. As the cosmic ocean of infinity, it is boundless and universal, for as William Blake wrote, "Who shall bind the Infinite?"
quotes.chapter: PISCES: The Search for the Castle of Peace

quotes.text: Spiritually, the Pisces lifetime is about dissolving of attachment without losing contact with feelings of kindness and compassion.
quotes.chapter: PISCES: The Search for the Castle of Peace

readings.name: The Self as their coniunctio
readings.statement: Sol and Luna, joined: the coniunctio oppositorum, which Jung calls the form the alchemists gave to the union of opposites. Of the Self he writes that it is a union of conscious (masculine) and unconscious (feminine).

cites.quote: The coniunctio oppositorum engaged the speculations of the alchemists
Psychologically the self is a union of conscious (masculine) and unconscious (feminine)
